items.title: Medtronic's Hugo surgical robot ready for bigger operation
items.summary: Medtronic's Hugo surgical robot features a modular design that allows surgeons to use only the robotic arms needed for any given procedure. | Source: Medtronic Medtronic this week announced the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has cleared the Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system for use in general surgery procedures. The approval enables the modular, cart-based system to perform surgeries across the abdomen. The clearance covers all upper abdominal general surgical procedures, including cholecystectomy, Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, ventral hernia, and small bowel resection. The FDA also cleared lower abdominal procedures of inguinal hernia and appendectomy.
